audit_scope.note: This is the GitHub summary layer. Planned deeper event-level history belongs in MongoDB Atlas after approval.

headline_findings.finding: Factory/Data Factory work is spread across ducklabms_code donor UI, fastapi-fabric, Contoso_Data_Fabric, fabricdatapasstoolbox, and fabric-toolbox_J.
headline_findings.resolution: FactoryLab owns the learning simulator; fabricdatapasstoolbox/fabric-toolbox_J remain real-Fabric tooling; Contoso_Data_Fabric is donor/reference unless explicitly promoted.

headline_findings.finding: PbiBench, TabularEditor_J, and planned PBI/Semantic Lab overlap strongly.
headline_findings.resolution: PBI Lab is the focused learning product; PbiBench and TabularEditor_J are donors/engineering tools, not parallel products.

headline_findings.finding: Airflow experiments exist in Datapass branches, old airflow_* repos, an empty datapass-airflow-runner, and planned Airflow Lab.
headline_findings.resolution: Airflow Lab owns deep Airflow practice; Datapass keeps only thin DAG coding; old airflow_* repos are references unless deliberately revived.

headline_findings.finding: Contoso-Data-Generator-V2, contoso-data-studio, and Contoso_Data_Fabric can look like competing products.
headline_findings.resolution: Generator-V2 = data generator; contoso-data-studio = canonical product; Contoso_Data_Fabric = donor/reference for Fabric-specific experiments.

headline_findings.finding: ducklabms_code contains many historic/integration/Codex branches after V1 qualification.
headline_findings.resolution: main is canonical; broad V1 is frozen except bugfix/extraction/refocus work. Historic branches must not silently become new authorities.
